rounds.title: Query error baseline
rounds.note: The SDK query error (et-query-error), first drawing, drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design, framed as its story does (max 520px, surface fill, 14px text). It is an et-banner of type error with a role=alert host: a 12px-rounded box tinted with 8% of the theme primary and edged with 1px of 24% primary, the 20px triangle icon in ink, an h3 title (14px, weight 600, full surface text), the message as a 14px muted paragraph or, for violations, a disc list, and a filled md et-button Retry when the retry policy allows one. The colour is the app's type error theme (danger here); the color input overrides it (brand-* states, as for a failure that should not read as alarming). States: message (403), violations (422 Symfony list), class-validator (400 list), retryable (503, retry), empty-body (500, status-table message with code, no retry: 500 is not retried by default), echoes-title (404, message replaced by the status text), network (status 0, connection failure, retry), always-allow-retry (404 with alwaysAllowRetry), long-message (wrapping text with an unbroken value), custom-slots (etQueryErrorTitle and etQueryErrorActions: sm button + a story link), retry-hover, retry-active, retry-focus-visible, slot-retry-focus-visible, brand-color, brand-retry-hover, brand-retry-focus-visible. long-message: the unbroken value wraps inside the banner since the lib fix b72c23c36 (overflow-wrap: anywhere on the banner heading and body). Numbers (light / dark), danger: title 15.88 / 16.41, message 6.92 / 6.63, icon (ink) 5.73 / 6.19 against the tint; Retry label 4.83 on the rest fill (both schemes); fill vs tint 4.28 / 3.55. Brand: title 17.24 / 14.66, message 7.51 / 5.92, icon 5.27 / 11.53, label 15.82, mint fill vs tint 1.28 / 11.53. Today: banner edge vs page danger 1.62 / 1.30, brand 1.15 / 2.24; focus ring in the fill colour, danger 5.73 / 2.65, mint 1.32 / 11.15 against the tint; filled hover takes the -hover token, danger 1.34:1 from rest, mint 1.03:1. Q98, numbers only: tint vs page danger 1.13 / 1.05, brand 1.04 / 1.17. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (ring on the Retry button), Q99a (accent edge of the banner, mint filled Retry), Q101 (filled Retry hover). Because b adds ink edges, Q102 arises: b keeps them in dark, c draws dark as today. Not this round's question: the button's own font.

a.note: Today: banner edge 24% primary, ring in the fill colour, hover the -hover token. Edge vs page danger 1.62 / 1.30, brand 1.15 / 2.24 (light / dark). Ring vs tint danger 5.73 / 2.65, mint 1.32 / 11.15. Hover vs rest danger 1.34, mint 1.03, label 6.47 / 15.30. Mint fill vs light tint 1.28.

b.note: Pick. Decided rules only: Q88 ring in ink (danger 7.36 / 9.02, mint 7.39 / 11.53 against the tint), Q99a banner border in ink (vs page danger 6.47 / 6.48, brand 5.48 / 13.50) and a 1px inset ink edge on the filled Retry (mint 4.13:1 against the fill in light; danger 1.34 light, 1.75 dark; in dark the brand ink is the mint, so it disappears there), Q101 hover = -active (danger 1.72:1 from rest, label 8.31; mint 1.69:1, label 9.38). Ink follows the scheme in both, matching the banner and button b picks, so a query error stays a banner. Q102 open: take c if dark should stay as today.

c.note: b with dark as today (Q102): banner border light-dark(ink, 24% primary), the Retry inset edge light-dark(ink, transparent). Light equals b (edge vs page danger 6.47, brand 5.48). Dark: banner edge danger 1.30, brand 2.24, as a; no button edge. Rings stay ink in both schemes (Q88: danger 9.02, mint 11.53 dark) and hover takes -active (Q101) as in b.
